idea-plugin.name: Git-Aware Dev Journal
idea-plugin.description:
Git-Aware Dev Journal — Remember Why You Wrote That Code

A development journal that links notes to your git context. Every entry captures the commit, branch, and file position automatically. Stop losing the reasoning behind your code decisions.

Features

  • Git-Linked Entries — each entry records the current branch and HEAD commit (Git plugin optional) plus file and line
  • 6 Entry Types — Notes, Decisions, TODOs, Blockers, Insights, Questions, with tags
  • Dev Journal Tool Window — sortable table with branch filter and text/tag search
  • Copy Standup — Markdown standup of recent entries (configurable time window)
  • Copy Branch Summary — all entries on the selected branch, grouped by type
  • Plain JSON Storage — .dev-journal/entries.json in your project, easy to commit and share

Requirements

  • IntelliJ IDEA 2023.2+ or another IntelliJ-based IDE
  • Git plugin (optional) for branch/commit capture

Support

Documentation | Issue Tracker | Contact Support

action.description: Add a development journal entry at the current cursor position

idea-plugin.change-notes:
2026.9.0

  • Added: Copy Standup and Copy Branch Summary buttons in the Dev Journal tool window (the standup time-window setting now has an effect).
  • Fixed: The tool window now refreshes when an entry is added via the editor action / shortcut.
  • Fixed: An absolute journal directory chosen in Settings was resolved under the project root.
  • Fixed: Journal files with missing fields (e.g. no tags) no longer cause errors when searching.
  • Fixed: File paths outside the project were shortened when they merely shared a name prefix with the project directory.
  • Removed: The "Auto-capture from conventional commits" setting — it never had any effect.
  • Removed: Documentation of features that do not exist (code hover, blame column, PR summaries, export, sync).

2026.8.0

  • The plugin is now completely free — all features unlocked, no license needed.
  • Source code is now open source under Apache-2.0: https://github.com/JirakJ/git-aware-dev-journal
